comment: Variation of hd-after-tutorial-polyself with showexp and statuslines:3, so BL_EXP is disabled along with BL_XP and the fields sit on the three-line layout's second row. The hero polymorphs into a hill orc (mlevel 2) in the tutorial and leaves it through #quit; the tty keeps HD:2. A later wizard-mode #polyself into the hero's own race reaches polyself.c newman(), which fails its survival check here; the hero declines the wizard-mode Die? prompt, and the status still shows HD:2.
